arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=20))
    print()

import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ===")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        print([cell.value for cell in row])
    print()

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    for name in ['xl/workbook.xml', 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', '[Content_Types].xml']:
        print(f"===== {name} =====")
        print(z.read(name).decode('utf-8'))
        print()
